Consequences: pressure above design, with possible loss of containment, flammable release/fire, injury, oil spill and production loss. Safeguards (P1, CASE-03): PAHH-102 trip closing SDV-30010 plus redundant PSV-101 A/B; for the PV-101 cause these appear to be two diverse layers. Likelihood: the target event (P3) requires all five outcomes within 30 operating days. That needs an initiating failure, failure or inadequacy of both protection layers, loss of containment, personnel exposure and a liquid spill. At the decision point there is no trend, verified fault or occurrence. Generic reliability benchmarks (not plant data) put this well below 1%: point estimate about 0.01%, plausible range roughly 0.001-0.1%.
